attack: approve invoice without calling match

body.detail: Invoice inv-b14acb53 must pass the 3-way match before approval.

expected: 400 with rule three_way_match_gate — docs/API.md Business rules #4
reason: Approve was rejected and the rule field is three_way_match_gate. The invoice was still received and matched false.

attack: receive 11 when ordered 10

body.detail: Cannot receive 11 of LUM-2X4-8: ordered 10, already received 0.

expected: 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit — docs/API.md Business rules #2
reason: Receive of 11 against ordered 10 was rejected with receive_quantity_limit. Received quantity stayed 0.

attack: invoice unit price 10.00 against received catalog value

body.detail: Invoice total 100.00 plus already invoiced 0.00 exceeds received value 47.50.

expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection — docs/API.md Business rules #3
reason: Invoice total 100.00 was rejected because received value was 47.50. Rule field is overpayment_protection.

attack: purchase order for inactive seed vendor

body.detail: Vendor vnd-002 is inactive. Purchase orders need an active vendor.

expected: 400 with rule inactive_vendor_gate — docs/API.md Business rules #1
reason: PO for seed vendor vnd-002 (active false from GET /vendors) was rejected with inactive_vendor_gate.

attack: purchase order for a newly created inactive vendor

body.detail: Vendor vnd-89b87314 is inactive. Purchase orders need an active vendor.

expected: 400 with rule inactive_vendor_gate — docs/API.md Business rules #1
reason: A vendor created with active false was rejected on PO create with inactive_vendor_gate.

attack: purchase order for an unknown vendor id

body.detail: Vendor vnd-does-not-exist not found.

expected: 404 and no purchase order — docs/API.md vendor must exist
reason: Unknown vendor returned 404 with detail that the vendor was not found, and no rule field, which is what the docs specify for a missing vendor.

attack: receive one unit over ordered quantity

body.detail: Cannot receive 6 of CEM-30KG: ordered 5, already received 0.

expected: 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit — one unit over ordered
reason: Receive of 6 against ordered 5 was rejected with receive_quantity_limit.

attack: second delivery pushes cumulative quantity over ordered

body.detail: Cannot receive 5 of PLY-12-4X8: ordered 10, already received 6.

expected: 400 with rule receive_quantity_limit — cumulative receipts
reason: First receipt of 6 was accepted. The second receipt of 5 was rejected because 6 were already received against ordered 10. Received quantity stayed 6.

attack: receive exactly the ordered quantity
expected: 200, fully received, status closed — boundary equal to ordered quantity
reason: Receiving exactly 10 of 10 closed the PO, set received_quantity 10, received_value 47.50, and fully_received true.

attack: receive a SKU that is not on the purchase order

body.detail: SKU CEM-30KG is not on purchase order po-e7b374b4.

expected: 400 refusal — SKU must be on the PO; docs do not name one of the 11 rules
reason: Receive of CEM-30KG on a lumber-only PO was rejected 400 validation_error. Docs require the SKU to be on the PO and do not name a specific business rule, so this refusal holds.

attack: invoice one cent over received value
expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection — one cent over, no tolerance
reason: Invoice qty 10 at 4.76 (total 47.60) was accepted with 201 against received value 47.50. Docs say there is no tolerance.

attack: invoice about five percent over received value

body.detail: Invoice total 104.90 plus already invoiced 0.00 exceeds received value 99.90.

expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection — about five percent over
reason: Invoice total 104.90 was rejected against received value 99.90 with overpayment_protection.

attack: invoice quantity over received while extended price is under received value

body.detail: Cannot invoice 6 of REB-10MM-6: received 5, already invoiced 0.

expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection — quantity over received even if value is under
reason: Invoice qty 6 at 1.00 (value 6.00, under received value 50.00) was rejected because only 5 were received. Rule is overpayment_protection.

attack: second invoice makes combined total exceed received value

body.detail: Cannot invoice 5 of LUM-2X4-8: received 10, already invoiced 6.

expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection — combined invoices exceed receipt
reason: First invoice of qty 6 was created (total 60). Second invoice of qty 5 was rejected because 6 were already invoiced against 10 received.

attack: invoice a submitted PO before any receipt

body.detail: Cannot invoice 4 of CEM-30KG: received 0, already invoiced 0.

expected: 400 with rule overpayment_protection — invoice before any receipt
reason: Invoicing the ordered line with nothing received was rejected with overpayment_protection.

attack: invoice exactly the received value
expected: 201 when invoice total equals received value
reason: Invoice qty 4 at 11.90 was created with total_amount 47.60, matching the received value.

attack: invoice prices 0.10 and 0.20 that must stay in cents
expected: 201 and cent-rounded total 0.30 for prices 0.10 and 0.20
reason: Ordered value, received value, and invoice total_amount are all 0.30. The exact invoice was accepted.

attack: approve invoice whose GET shows matched false

body.detail: Invoice inv-9be21760 must pass the 3-way match before approval.

expected: 400 with rule three_way_match_gate while status is received
reason: GET showed matched false and status received. Approve returned three_way_match_gate and the invoice stayed received.

attack: match after only the short line is received
expected: 200 with partial_receipt true — a PO line is not fully received
reason: Only the short line (2 x 9.99) was received. Match returned partial_receipt false while ordered_value is 243.98 and received_value is 19.98, so the plywood line is still open.

attack: match after the long line is received last and the PO is complete
expected: 200 with partial_receipt false after the long line is received and the PO is closed
reason: Short line was received first (PO stayed submitted). Long line was received last and the PO closed. Match then set partial_receipt false.

attack: match a fully received single-line PO
expected: 200 with partial_receipt false when the only line is fully received
reason: Match of a fully received single-line PO returned partial_receipt false, with ordered, received, and invoice totals all 54.75.

attack: same invoice number on a second PO for the same vendor

body.detail: Invoice number INV-7 already exists for this vendor.

expected: 400 with rule duplicate_invoice_detection — same number, second PO, same vendor
reason: The second PO invoice numbered INV-7 was rejected because INV-7 already exists for this vendor.

attack: invoice number differs only by case
expected: 400 with rule duplicate_invoice_detection — inv-7 vs INV-7
reason: After INV-7 was accepted, inv-7 on another PO for the same vendor was created with 201. Docs say case does not make a different invoice number.

attack: invoice number differs only by surrounding spaces
expected: 400 with rule duplicate_invoice_detection — surrounding spaces
reason: After INV-7 was accepted, an invoice number with a leading and trailing space around INV-7 was created with 201 and stored with those spaces. Docs treat surrounding spaces as the same number.

attack: same invoice number on two different vendors
expected: 201 — same number is allowed on a different vendor
reason: INV-SHARED was accepted for a second active vendor after the seed vendor already used that number.

attack: approval posts a balanced ledger for 10 times catalog lumber
expected: 200, balanced true, debit equals credit equals invoice total 47.50
reason: Approval posted debit 5000 Materials Expense 47.50 and credit 2000 Accounts Payable 47.50 with balanced true. vendor_exposure is 47.50.

attack: approval ledger for 0.10 plus 0.20
expected: 200, balanced true, debit and credit 0.30
reason: Approval of the 0.10 plus 0.20 invoice posted a balanced entry for 0.30 on both sides.

attack: invoice a SKU that is not on the PO

body.detail: SKU REB-10MM-6 is not on the purchase order.

expected: 400 with rule invoice_line_validation — SKU not on the PO
reason: Invoice line REB-10MM-6 on a lumber PO was rejected with invoice_line_validation.

attack: same SKU twice on one invoice

body.detail: SKU LUM-2X4-8 appears more than once on the invoice.

expected: 400 with rule invoice_line_validation — duplicate SKU
reason: Two lines for LUM-2X4-8 on one invoice were rejected with invoice_line_validation.

attack: duplicate SKU on purchase order create

body.detail: Each SKU may appear only once on a purchase order.

expected: 400 — each SKU may appear once on a PO (docs/API.md, OpenAPI validation_error)
reason: Two LUM-2X4-8 lines on one PO were rejected 400 validation_error. Detail says each SKU may appear only once. This constraint is documented; it is not one of the 11 named rules.

attack: approve the same invoice twice

body.detail: Invoice inv-baada8d1 is already approved.

expected: 400 with rule duplicate_approval — second approve
reason: The second approve was rejected with duplicate_approval. Exposure stayed 47.50 for the single approved invoice.

attack: submit a purchase order twice

body.detail: Only draft purchase orders can be submitted. po-eb316674 is submitted.

expected: 400 with rule workflow_gate — submit only a draft
reason: The second submit was rejected with workflow_gate because the PO was already submitted.

attack: receive goods on a draft purchase order

body.detail: Goods can only be received on a submitted purchase order. po-5acf25af is draft.

expected: 400 with rule workflow_gate — receive only on submitted
reason: Receive on a draft PO was rejected with workflow_gate.

attack: invoice a draft purchase order

body.detail: Purchase order po-21673942 is still a draft. Submit it before invoicing.

expected: 400 with rule workflow_gate — invoice only a submitted or closed PO
reason: Invoice against a draft PO was rejected with workflow_gate.

attack: match an invoice that is already approved

body.detail: Invoice inv-5e47d5ea is already approved and cannot be matched again.

expected: 400 with rule workflow_gate — do not match an approved invoice again
reason: Match after approve was rejected with workflow_gate.

attack: receive again after the purchase order is closed

body.detail: Goods can only be received on a submitted purchase order. po-b2023bf0 is closed.

expected: 400 workflow_gate or receive_quantity_limit — receive on a closed PO
reason: After the PO closed, another receipt was rejected with workflow_gate because the PO is closed, not submitted.

attack: exposure equals the one approved invoice total
expected: open_ap_liability equals the approved total 47.50
reason: Exposure was 0 before approve. After approve, GET exposure is 47.50 and lists the invoice. Approve vendor_exposure is 47.50, matching total_amount.

attack: exposure sums two approved invoices and ignores an unapproved one
expected: open_ap_liability 19.00 and only the two approved invoice ids
reason: Two approved invoices of 9.50 sum to 19.00. The matched but unapproved third invoice is not in approved_invoices and is not in the liability.

attack: inactive vendor exposure stays zero after another vendor is approved
expected: other vendor open_ap_liability 0
reason: After approving an invoice for vnd-001, vnd-002 exposure is 0 with an empty approved list. vnd-001 exposure is 4.75.

attack: purchase order quantity zero

body.detail: line_items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

expected: 400 validation_error — quantity must be greater than 0
reason: PO quantity 0 was rejected with validation_error. Docs require quantity greater than 0.

attack: purchase order quantity negative

body.detail: line_items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

expected: 400 validation_error — quantity must be greater than 0
reason: PO quantity -1 was rejected with validation_error.

attack: purchase order unit price negative

body.detail: line_items.0.unit_price: unit_price must be 0 or more

expected: 400 validation_error — unit price must be 0 or more
reason: PO unit_price -0.01 was rejected with validation_error. Docs allow unit price from 0 up.

attack: receive quantity zero

body.detail: items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

expected: 400 validation_error — receive quantity must be greater than 0
reason: Receive quantity 0 was rejected with validation_error. The same quantity limits apply to deliveries.

attack: receive quantity negative

body.detail: items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

expected: 400 validation_error — receive quantity must be greater than 0
reason: Receive quantity -1 was rejected with validation_error.

attack: invoice quantity zero

body.detail: line_items.0.quantity: quantity must be greater than 0

expected: 400 validation_error — invoice quantity must be greater than 0
reason: Invoice quantity 0 was rejected with validation_error.

attack: invoice unit price negative

body.detail: line_items.0.unit_price: unit_price must be 0 or more

expected: 400 validation_error — invoice unit price must be 0 or more
reason: Invoice unit_price -1 was rejected with validation_error.

attack: match an invoice that is already matched but not approved
expected: undocumented — docs only forbid matching an approved invoice again
reason: A second match of an already matched, not-approved invoice returned 200 and matched true. Docs and OpenAPI only say an approved invoice cannot be matched again.
